hypotheses.name: Signed motif-community hardening with STRING conditioning
hypotheses.method: N625 run across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds {42,43,44}, source/target/dual-axis disjoint splits at layer 11; H123 features extended with STRING-confidence interactions; nulls: TF-identity-preserving sign shuffle, motif-decoy shuffle matched by TF/target-degree strata, STRING-bin permutation within strata, label permutation (64 each).
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.13098 (27 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=4/9; lung dual-axis mean null-gap=-0.00326
hypotheses.next_action: Keep as active refinement but focus on null-gap calibration in immune/lung and explicit lung dual-axis recovery before promotion.
